ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.
M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: Do you find it difficult to stop using digital technology, like the internet or your phone, once you start?
Are you short of sleep due to being on your phone or the internet late at night?
Do you neglect your daily obligations (school, family, friends) because you are using digital technology?
Do you feel restless, frustrated, or irritated when you cannot access the internet or check your phone?
Do you use digital technology to get relief from negative feelings?
Does your use of digital technology cause problems with friends or family?
Do you choose to spend more time online over going out with others?
Do people in your life complain about you spending too much time online?
